steps.text: The sky is a strange color.
The sun is dark. The clouds are gray. The sky begins to split in the distance, the crack spreading along its center.
But all this is no longer important.
You remember this day.
You can never forget it.
It is like a prophecy destined to come true, one known by everyone.
It is like a nightmare that can never be shaken, always entwining.
You cannot tell if this is just a play.
Perhaps your entire life is just a play, in the eyes of another.
Abyss.
You ask yourself.
The actor on the stage must follow his script. But what about you?
What choice will you make?

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: I can't do it.

steps.name: Sad Man
steps.text: Don't show mercy, Abyss.

steps.name: Sad Man
steps.text: The others would still be alive if I hadn't screwed up.

steps.name: Sad Man
steps.text: You have a chance to make things right. Bring back my head and—

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Shut up! Don't make me regret this!

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Don't show mercy?

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Then what am I supposed to do?

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: I'm supposed to kill you, take your head and bring it back.

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Bide my time, wait for the chance to take revenge...

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: No, that's not right.

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: ...Take this.

steps.name: Sad Man
steps.text: Your dagger...

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Take it. Go.

steps.name: Sad Man
steps.text: Abyss!

steps.name: Sad Man
steps.text: What are you going to do, then, if you let me go?
You made your choice, once again.
You know what you have to do, don't you?

steps.name: Kind Villager
steps.text: Thanks for taking care of the kids for the past few days, young man.

steps.name: Kind Villager
steps.text: They say you're a great storyteller!

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: You're welcome, sir.

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: They're all good kids. We should be the ones thanking you for giving us a place to stay.

steps.name: Kind Villager
steps.text: Oh, no, no, it was no trouble at all.

steps.name: Kind Villager
steps.text: I'll leave you to your work, then.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Telling stories to children?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Looks like you're getting along well with the villagers.

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Doesn't take much effort to move your mouth and tongue.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Well, it takes patience I don't have.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Things have been calm here, too calm. The mission's going too smoothly. I'm not used to this.

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Calm isn't bad.

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Certainly better than running into unexpected trouble...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: I know, I know, your dream is to retire quietly.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Oh yeah.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: I have a gift for you.

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Oh? What is it?
A round object falls on the ground before you.
It is slightly rotten, and makes a dull thud as it lands.
Your 'gift' rolls along on the ground, stopping at your feet.
The gaze of its lifeless eyes meets yours.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: I brought his weapon back, too.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: This is yours, isn't it?

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: But... why...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: The one you let get away.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Suddenly, the past catches up to you, just when you thought you'd finally escaped it.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: It was the right decision to not kill him, Abyss.

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: The right decision?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: It makes the script even better.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: What's the matter, Abyss? Isn't this the script you wrote for the troupe?

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Script...?

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: No, no!

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: I have nothing to do with the troupe! I ran away from it a long time ago!

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: This isn't a script! It can't be!

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: It was my own choice...

steps.name: Sad Man
steps.text: What choice?

steps.name: Sad Man
steps.text: What are you talking about, Abyss?

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: It was... my own...

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: It was right that I didn't kill you?

steps.name: Sad Man
steps.text: No, no.

steps.name: Sad Man
steps.text: I don't know what's vexing you, but the best way is to kill me.

steps.name: Sad Man
steps.text: No need to take risks. Just carry out the plan—

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: No!

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: There is no plan! It's not time for you to die yet!

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Go! I'll come with you!

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: We can all get out. We just need to be careful this time... don't get caught...

steps.name: Sad Man
steps.text: Calm down, Abyss.

steps.name: Sad Man
steps.text: I can't escape. It was enough that I got to see you in the end.

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: What are you doing?

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Stop! Stop!

steps.name: Sad Man
steps.text: I can't let get you into trouble.

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: ...Tell me you're joking.

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Get up! Stop acting!

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Get up! We need to go, or it'll be too late!

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Say something!

steps.name: Sad Man
steps.text: There's no other way, Abyss.

steps.name: Sad Man
steps.text: Kill me and take my head back.

steps.name: Sad Man
steps.text: Do you hear me?

steps.name: Sad Man
steps.text: Kill me! We don't have time!

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Kill you?

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Put my dagger in your heart like this, and watch you die?

steps.name: Sad Man
steps.text: Yes, that's right.

steps.name: Sad Man
steps.text: You made the right choice, Abyss...

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Did I?

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Was it really my choice?

a.text: Everything about 'Abyss' was created by the troupe. The 'self' that you had sought...

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Ha... haha...

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: You'll die. I know you'll die.

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Your head will inevitably be separated from your neck. I just hope it won't have to fall into the dust and dirt.

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: That's why this time, I'll cut your head off myself.

steps.name: Head
steps.text: Is that your prophecy, Abyss?

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: I'm not a prophet. I just saw it.

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: I saw you die. You'll die, even if I let you go.

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: I ran, but I could never get away.

steps.name: Head
steps.text: Of course you can't.

steps.name: Head
steps.text: You'll never escape their eyes, no matter how well you hide.

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: ...Who's watching me?

steps.name: Head
steps.text: The audience, of course.

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Audience... audience?

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Why are they watching me? If I screw up, all they'll do is get rid of me.

steps.name: Head
steps.text: Certainly, there are those who are angry at your docile performance on stage. But that's to be expected.

steps.name: Head
steps.text: We all know this is where the allure of art truly lies.

steps.name: Head
steps.text: A good play with good actors should be able to move people's emotions, don't you think?

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: No... that's not what it is! It can't be!

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: It was my choice to let you go! It's not their will!

steps.name: Head
steps.text: If you're really sure about that...

steps.name: Head
steps.text: Then why are you still trapped in this nightmare?

steps.name: Head
steps.text: Why does that day keep repeating itself, even though you've already escaped?

steps.name: Head
steps.text: Why do you keep trying anything you can to detach me from that body and bring me back with you?

steps.name: Head
steps.text: You're afraid, Abyss.

steps.name: Head
steps.text: Letting me go was your first and only act of defiance.

steps.name: Head
steps.text: Running away from the troupe took all the courage you had.

steps.name: Head
steps.text: The Blood Diamond had come for you, but all you could do was hide.

steps.name: Head
steps.text: You were always more afraid of this all being part of some plan than of actually getting caught.

steps.name: Head
steps.text: You don't like being seen, because you're afraid that your 'true self' doesn't actually exist here.

steps.name: Head
steps.text: Am I wrong?

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Shut your trap.

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: You're just a phantom in my dreams. You don't exist!

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: And don't call me Abyss.
Don't call me by that name!

steps.name: Broken Skull
steps.text: Poor thing. You couldn't kill your fear. You couldn't silence your doubts.

steps.name: Broken Skull
steps.text: You know it's anathema to seek the self.

steps.name: Broken Skull
steps.text: But it can achieve great art!

steps.name: Broken Skull
steps.text: Even now, you continue to contribute to the stage! They were wrong about you. You're a great actor!
Shut up! I'm not acting!
I'll free myself from you. I'll kill you!
I won't go back on stage. I'm not Abyss. My life is not a play!

steps.name: Broken Skull
steps.text: You and your tiny, tiny resolve.

steps.name: Broken Skull
steps.text: Then let me ask you.

steps.name: Broken Skull
steps.text: Who are you, if not Abyss?
I am—

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: ...lem?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Shalem?

steps.name: Shalem
steps.text: I... I'm here.

steps.name: Shalem
steps.text: Sorry, I was distracted... did something happen?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: What were you daydreaming about?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Not that it matters. It just sounded like you were talking to someone, so I came over and saw you staring into space.

steps.name: Shalem
steps.text: ...You were hearing things. I'm the only one here.

steps.name: Shalem
steps.text: There's no one else.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Really? Guess I should get my hearing checked.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Oh yeah, ■■.
What did you just call me?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Huh? ■■.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: What's the matter? Isn't that your callsign?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Never mind that. Look—

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: I have a gift for you.
A gift?
